ValidationRule.description: Rule to make the closure comments field mandatory, when the opportunity is closed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( NOT( CreatedBy.FirstName = 'Data'), NOT( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Loyalty_Commercial'), NOT( $User.ProfileId = '00e90000001wK8z'), /*SysAdmins*/ NOT( RecordTypeId = "01290000001YbyD"), /*B&G Campaigns*/ NOT ( ISPICKVAL( Type , "Global Opportunity")), /*Global Opportunity*/ OR ( ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Closed Lost"), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Closed - Accepted"), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Closed - Not Accepted") ), ISBLANK(Other_reasons__c) )
